sqlMap.select: SELECT T.CUST_NO, T.ORD_CNT, (SELECT C.CUST_NM FROM TB_CUST_M C WHERE C.CUST_NO = T.CUST_NO) AS custNm FROM ( SELECT CUST_NO, COUNT(*) AS ORD_CNT, SUM(TOT_AMT) AS SUM_AMT FROM TB_ORD_H WHERE ORD_DT >= #fromDt# GROUP BY CUST_NO ) T WHERE T.SUM_AMT > #minAmt# ORDER BY T.ORD_CNT DESC
SELECT X.ORD_NO AS ordNo, X.ORD_DT AS ordDt FROM (SELECT * FROM TB_ORD_H WHERE ORD_STAT_CD = '90') X
